title: Customized greeting
description: Ask the user for their name and favorite color, and show a customized greeting with that information.
hints: Use System.out.print() (without ln) for the prompt message
Remember to close the Scanner with sc.close()
solutionExplanation: We use nextLine() to read both the name and the color, since both may contain spaces. The greeting concatenates the variables with literal text.
expectedOutput:
What's your name? Carlos
What is your favorite color? azul
Hello Carlos! Your favorite color is azul

title: Calculator with Scanner
description: Create a calculator that asks the user for two numbers and shows their sum, subtraction, multiplication and division. Handle division by zero.
hints: Remember to clear the buffer with sc.nextLine() after each nextDouble
Check that the divisor is not 0 before dividing
solutionExplanation: We use nextDouble() to read decimal numbers and clear the buffer after each read. We check that b is not 0 before dividing to avoid an ArithmeticException.
expectedOutput:
First number: 10
Second number: 3

--- Results ---
Sum: 13.00
Difference: 7.00
Product: 30.00
Division: 3.33

title: Form with validation
description: Create a form that asks for name, age (greater than 0, less than 150), email (must contain @) and phone (digits only). Validate each field and repeat until valid data is obtained.
hints: Use while(!valid) to repeat each field
Use String.matches("\\d+") to check for digits only
solutionExplanation: Each field has its own validation loop. For the name we use isEmpty(), for age hasNextInt() with a range, for email contains("@"), and for phone the regex \d{10}. Each field repeats until it is valid.
expectedOutput:
Name: 
❌ The name cannot be empty
Name: Carlos
Age: abc
❌ It must be a whole number
Age: 25
Email: carlos
❌ The email must contain @
Email: carlos@ejemplo.com
Phone (10 digits): 123
❌ It must have exactly 10 digits
Phone (10 digits): 5551234567

=== Registration successful ===
Name: Carlos
Age: 25
Email: carlos@ejemplo.com
Phone: 5551234567
